_doc: Plain-language standard data. Read by scripts/check_plain_language.mjs and linked from CLAUDE.md. Add terms here, never in CLAUDE.md. Each term's `match` is a regex source, matched case-insensitively with \b on both ends. `maxGrade` is what the hook blocks on; `targetGrade` is documentation only (and the second grade column of --report). `allow` entries are { file, path | key, term | rule } — `en.json` can only be allowed here, since JSON has no comments. `spelling` holds the British → American map and the `keep` phrases for the American-spelling rule (CLAUDE.md 'American spelling'): the hook reports it as rule `spelling`, and `npm run check:spelling` fails the build on any.

spelling._doc: British → American, parent-facing English only (CLAUDE.md 'American spelling'). Keys are lowercase whole words; matching is case-insensitive and the fix keeps the original's case (Programme → Program, PROGRAMME → PROGRAM). `keep` phrases are masked before matching (case-sensitive): official names and proper nouns. Quotes, URLs and citations are exempt as in the jargon rule. theatre/theater are deliberately NOT here — both are American usage and ~100 uses are names (user, 2026-11-09). Also deliberately absent: enrolled, enrolling, towards, dialogue, archaeology, aesthetic, analyses.
